Constraint: second-stage Cf: needs >=20 uF effective at 3.3 V bias, total <200 uF. Any 22 uF 0805 6.3 V+ part meets this.
VIN high-frequency cap: needs >=25 V rating. 0402 parts are 50 V by default.

MUST be >=16 V. VIN is raw pack: 7.4 V nominal, 8.4 V on a full 2S, and CR1 does not clamp until 11.1 V. The default 22 uF 0805 at every distributor is 6.3 V or 10 V -- a 6.3 V part would be operated over its rating. 2 x 10 uF 25 V is TI's own reference value (SLVSFP4B CIN), clears the 5 uF effective minimum after DC-bias derating, and halves hot-plug inrush versus 2 x 22 uF.
C_NR/SS: TI characterisation value, sets a 5.0 ms soft start.

MUST land 40-80 uF EFFECTIVE at 3.33 V bias (SLVSFP4B 8.2.2.2.3 -- the loop compensation is internal and non-adjustable). Verify against the part's DC-bias curve, not the nameplate: a common 22 uF 0805 6.3 V X5R derates to ~10-12 uF each, giving 30-36 uF, which is BELOW the minimum. The X7S part above holds ~15-16 uF each, ~46 uF total.

Do not substitute SMF12A. Standoff 10 V clears a full 8.4 V 2S pack; Vc max 17 V at 11.8 A stays under the TPS62913's 18 V absolute maximum with 1 V to spare. SMF12A clamps at 19.9 V and would exceed it.

Green Vf (~1.8-2.4 V) is load-bearing on D1: it is the only thing holding TIMEPULSE/SAFEBOOT_N above the safeboot threshold at startup. Do not fit a low-Vf part and do not replace D1 with a plain resistor to ground.
20 ohm at 100 MHz / 8 mohm DCR / 5 A. L ~= 31.8 nH, inside the 50 nH stability limit for the internal compensation (SLVSFP4B 8.2.2.2.4).
Pads are tied to GND. Note DIN965 is a countersunk head and will not seat flat on a plain pad.
Pin 5 carries TIMEPULSE (PPS) on this board. On gnss-px1105r the same pin is RXD2, driven by the host. See the board-identification note.
LED series. At 10 k both LEDs run 0.13 mA and are barely visible indoors; 1.5-2.2 k gives ~7x brightness and stays inside the 2 mA TIMEPULSE limit.
R7/R8 are UART series protection; R9 is the PPS series resistor into J3.5.
FB divider high side. With R6 and Vfb = 0.800 V this sets 3.330 V.
